match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett applies the lipstick in the moving reflection as the apartment door swings shut behind her. Framing: medium close-up, eye level, Scarlett’s face and moving reflection fill the mirrored cabinet, with the coral lipstick and bright doorway held in shallow-focus background. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett pauses before the medicine-cabinet mirror with the uncapped coral lipstick in hand, surprised by the color on her skin. Camera, as one or two arrows: push-in, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
